description.zh: 背包和工作台制作可使用同列车玩家储物箱的材料。开始制作时补齐背包缺料，关闭制作界面时退回未用完的搬入材料。仅单人或房主生效。
description.en: Craft with materials from player storage on the same train. Missing materials move into your backpack when crafting starts; unused borrowed materials return when you close crafting. Single player or host only.
